title: EBH-6 closure rests on an unnamed independent auditor; independence basis not stated
impact: EBH-6 is 'INDEPENDENTLY ACCEPTED' but no record names the auditor, session or method; the other four stages name an external model session. Replay attestation bundles still read independent_disposition PENDING. Test evidence (275/10/11 passed) is in-repo and sound; only the independence attribution is missing.
recommendation: Owner records auditor identity/session and independence basis for E01-PRE-01/E02-AUD-01/B6, or re-accepts via an IIAC or delegated session.

title: DUP-X, ROADMAP-REPLAY-X (and EBH-7 GHA run) acceptance rests on auditor log inspection of artefacts absent from the repo
impact: The external auditor did not re-run pytest (DUP-X L25; EBH-7 L16); the 44/480/32-passed logs live in gitignored .tmp/proof paths and exports/ROADMAP_REPLAY_X_B6_R2_FINAL_AUDIT.zip, none present at baseline (no exports/ dir). Counts are only re-derivable by Campaign B. Test defs at baseline match 44 for dup_x.
recommendation: Campaign B replays dup_x, roadmap_replay_x and ebh_7 profile at an agreed pin; owner commits the digests or log manifest.

title: NPSC-4.2 allowlist 'FAIL retained' text vs allowlist gate refreshed under EBH-7 W3 without recorded result
impact: DUP-X and REPLAY-X accepted the exclusion on a FAIL (10 modules). EBH-7 W3 changed the gate semantics (execution-owner zone skipped, caller allowlists) as a 'Class B' refresh with no pass/fail result in the record. A read-only static emulation of the gate finds 0 violations at baseline, but nothing documents the gate as PASS or the roadmap text as superseded.
recommendation: Run the NPSC-4.2 gate (Campaign B) and annotate DUP-X/REPLAY-X/roadmap rows as superseded or still FAIL; review the semantic relaxation.

impact: Register lists OD-EVOL-11, OD-EVOL-FORMAL, OD-ENT-00, OD-ENT-01, OD-ENT-08 OPEN and OD-ENT-02 BLOCKED_EXTERNAL; roadmap L572 states EVOL-X and ENT-AUDIT-X CLOSED and published. Either the register is stale or the closures lack the ODs. OD-ARCH-FREEZE-01 OPEN is expected.
